summary: Extracted product specifications, qualified pilot results, first-year pricing, deployment steps, and supported media for a product and pricing website. The supplied source describes a synthetic evaluation company.

facts.text: Lumen Labs is presented in a synthetic evaluation source, not as a real company.
Lumen Labs launched the S2 sensor in March 2025 for indoor logistics.
The sensor's temperature range is 0–50 °C. Stated accuracy is ±0.3 °C only within 10–35 °C.
The replaceable battery lasts up to 18 months at 20 °C; this lifetime is not stated for all temperatures. Replacement batteries are sold separately.

A non-randomized May 2025 pilot at 24 sites reported median processing time 18% lower, excluding installation and setup time. This result applies to the pilot and is not a guaranteed customer outcome.
The vendor claims simpler maintenance; no independent maintenance study is supplied.
Basic costs USD 240 annually for the first year only, supports up to 10 seats, and includes CSV export. Tax and setup are excluded.
Team costs USD 480 annually for the first year only, supports up to 30 seats, and includes CSV and JSON export. Tax and setup are excluded.
Deployment requires calibrating before attaching the sensor, pairing over Bluetooth, and then confirming a timestamped sample.
An assembly demonstration video is supplied. Its caption explicitly shows calibration and pairing.
The intended deliverable is a product and pricing website.

limitations: No product photograph is supplied; the available video has not been visually inspected.
Pricing is specified for the first year only; subsequent-year pricing is not supplied.
Setup is excluded from the listed prices, and no setup price is supplied.
The pilot is non-randomized, excludes installation/setup time, and does not establish a guaranteed customer outcome.
No independent maintenance study or outdoor certification is supplied.
